title: Non-anticoagulant heparin alleviates myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury through inhibiting GSDMD-mediated cardiomyocyte pyroptosis via the HMGB1/RAGE pathway.
authors: Wang, Xuewen; Liang, Ziwei; Liu, Mingxin; Ouyang, Jie; Gao, Peng; Pan, Gang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究非抗凝肝素通过HMGB1/RAGE通路抑制心肌细胞焦亡减轻缺血再灌注损伤，核心为蛋白-蛋白互作与疾病机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模及AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Heparin reduces myocardial ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury, which is associated with pyroptosis. As a derivative of heparin, non-anticoagulant heparin (NAH) is rarely researched in this field. This study aims to explore the mechanisms of NAH in myocardial I/R injury and pyroptosis. METHODS: Cardiomyocytes (H9C2) were exposed to hypoxia/reoxygenation (H/R) to simulate myocardial I/R injury in vitro. Cells were treated with NAH, ov-gasdermin D (GSDMD), ov-caspase 11, H(2)O(2), N-acetyl-L-cysteine (NAC), and recombinant HMGB1 (rHMGB1). The binding of NAH to HMGB1 was detected by molecular docking and DARTS. For in vivo validation, C57BL/6 J male mice underwent myocardial I/R surgery and received NAH and rHMGB1 treatment. RESULTS: NAH inhibited H/R-induced pyroptosis of H9C2 cells as evidenced by decreased caspase 11/GSDMD activation, decreased IL-18/IL-1beta/LDH release, and increased ATP yields. These effects were attenuated by caspase 11 or GSDMD-N overexpression. Similar to NAC, NAH inhibited H/R and H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative stress. Moreover, NAH reversed the promoting effects of rHMGB1 on cell pyroptosis and oxidative stress. Mechanistically, NAH bound to HMGB1, blocking HMGB1/RAGE interaction. In mice, NAH alleviated myocardial infarction, injury, fibrosis, pyroptosis, and oxidative stress. These effects were reversed by rHMGB1. CONCLUSIONS: NAH protects against myocardial I/R injury by inhibiting GSDMD-mediated pyroptosis via the HMGB1/RAGE pathway. NAH may serve as a potential drug for treating myocardial I/R injury.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝素可减轻心肌缺血再灌注（I/R）损伤，该过程与焦亡相关。作为肝素的衍生物，非抗凝肝素（NAH）在该领域的研究较少。本研究旨在探讨NAH在心肌I/R损伤及焦亡中的作用机制。方法：将心肌细胞（H9C2）暴露于缺氧/复氧（H/R）以在体外模拟心肌I/R损伤。细胞分别用NAH、ov-gasdermin D（GSDMD）、ov-caspase 11、H(2)O(2)、N-乙酰-L-半胱氨酸（NAC）和重组HMGB1（rHMGB1）处理。通过分子对接和DARTS检测NAH与HMGB1的结合。体内验证中，C57BL/6 J雄性小鼠接受心肌I/R手术，并给予NAH和rHMGB1治疗。结果：NAH抑制了H/R诱导的H9C2细胞焦亡，表现为caspase 11/GSDMD激活减少、IL-18/IL-1beta/LDH释放降低以及ATP产量增加。这些效应被caspase 11或GSDMD-N过表达所减弱。与NAC类似，NAH抑制了H/R和H(2)O(2)诱导的氧化应激。此外，NAH逆转了rHMGB1对细胞焦亡和氧化应激的促进作用。机制上，NAH与HMGB1结合，阻断HMGB1/RAGE相互作用。在小鼠中，NAH减轻了心肌梗死、损伤、纤维化、焦亡和氧化应激。这些效应被rHMGB1逆转。结论：NAH通过HMGB1/RAGE通路抑制GSDMD介导的焦亡，从而保护心肌免受I/R损伤。NAH可能作为治疗心肌I/R损伤的潜在药物。
